deals.headline: 1. FC Köln GmbH & Co. KGaA issues up to €15.5m of 3.5% bonds due 2024
deals.investor: Bondholders (FC-Anleihe 2016|2024, public offer and exchange offer)
deals.summary: Unsecured, unsubordinated 3.5% bonds 2016|2024 (a book-entry bond and a printed 'Schmuckanleihe') offered in Germany and Austria by exchange offer and public subscription, capped at €15.5m in total. The 2024/25 results say the club repaid €14m of interest-bearing financing that year.

deals.evidence: Fußball-Bundesligist 1. FC Köln hat beim Land Nordrhein-Westfalen eine Landesbürgschaft in Höhe von 20 Millionen Euro beantragt.
deals.headline: 1. FC Köln applies for a €20m state guarantee on a six-year house-bank loan
deals.investor: FC house bank, with a guarantee from the state of North Rhine-Westphalia
deals.summary: During the pandemic the club applied to North Rhine-Westphalia for a €20m state guarantee on a six-year loan from its house bank (interest only for two years, then €5m a year), alongside a working-capital line and a €5m loan.

deals.evidence: Diese Kredite werden noch bis zum 30. Juni 2021 eingesammelt, am Ende soll ein zweistelliger Millionenbetrag stehen.
deals.headline: 1. FC Köln raises mezzanine loans in the double-digit millions
deals.summary: Subordinated mezzanine loans collected until 30 June 2021, targeting a double-digit million amount; the lenders get no say or influence, and the club stated it opposes selling shares to investors.

Fußball-Club Köln 01/07 e.V. is its sole limited shareholder with 100% of the share capital and also owns 100% of the general partner, 1. FC Köln Verwaltungs GmbH (2016 bond prospectus). The club states it is free of investors; it had over 150,000 members in August 2025 and 160,000 in January 2026.
